result.summary: Found 1 major visual issue: a loading spinner is overlaying a restaurant card image, making it appear unfinished or stuck.

issues.description: A loading spinner is visible in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar cover image in the 'Popular right now' section, indicating the image is still loading or the spinner failed to hide.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image loads and hide the spinner once loading is complete; add a fallback placeholder for failed image loads.
